paper_title: Astrophysical limits on very light axion-like particles from Chandra grating spectroscopy of NGC 1275
notes: Astrophysical bound (X-ray transparency of ICM, not a DM haloscope so no DM density). 99.7% credible region: g_agamma < 6.3e-13 GeV^-1 (Model-A) and < 7.9e-13 GeV^-1 (Model-B) for m_a < 1e-12 eV. The conservative limit (Model-B, 7.9e-13) is used as a flat upper limit across the constrained mass range below 1e-12 eV.
